notes.title: Prepare for Warehouse Horror!
notes.content:
Step into a world where every shadow hides a mystery, and every corner of the remote warehouse is filled with dread. Our new horror game offers an unforgettable experience that will test your nerves and courage.

Are you ready to take on the challenge of surviving night shifts while monitoring cameras and battling sinister anomalies? The silence of the warehouse is interrupted by strange occurrences that seem harmless at first—objects moving, lights flickering. But with each passing night, the terror intensifies.

Your only mission is to survive. But how long can you last before fear overwhelms you? Anomalies multiply, the warehouse shifts, and missing even one warning sign could spell the end for you. Your only defense is the cameras, which you must constantly switch between, turn off, and monitor every detail.

Each night brings new horrors. The warehouse, once ordinary, becomes a place where reality blurs with nightmares, and every sound or movement could mean danger is lurking. Can you keep your composure and survive the terrors hiding in the dark, or will you become the next victim of this haunted place?

This is more than just a game. It’s a test of your endurance, your nerves, and your ability to stay alive when everything seems to be against you. The horrors of the warehouse await. Are you ready to face your deepest fears?
[b]
And we're not done yet![/b] Development is ongoing, and we are committed to gradually adding new content to ensure that the dread continues to build with every night. Stay tuned, because the darkness is far from over.

[b]The game is available now! Take on the night shift and see if you can survive the entire week.[/b]

notes.title: Night Shift: Warehouse is coming soon!
notes.content:
Get Ready for the Frightening Atmosphere: "Night Shift Warehouse" is coming soon!

Step into the mysterious world of our latest horror game, where every shadow holds a secret and every sound could spell danger. As the night watchman of an isolated warehouse, you face the challenge of surviving restless nights filled with unexplained phenomena.

What Awaits You:

[b]Intense Atmosphere[/b]: Every corner of the warehouse is filled with terror. Your vigilance will be tested to the max as you monitor cameras and identify ominous anomalies.

[b]Rising Tension[/b]: Anomalies increase each day, requiring quick responses, camera switching, and constant alertness for survival.

[b]A True Test of Nerves[/b]: Surviving the night shifts for an entire week demands all your attention and strategic thinking.

Add "Night Shift Warehouse" to your wishlist on Steam and be ready for unparalleled action when the game launches! Immerse yourself in the darkness and find out if you can last until dawn.

Can you keep calm as things spiral out of control? Accept the challenge and find out for yourself!
